capacity.note: DEPRECATED 2026-09-09: steady_delivered_eps counts warm-up backlog draining through the window as throughput (measured 1.26-1.32x inflation on every 2026-08 run) and CAN exceed the offered rate. Quote reconciled.delivered_window_eps instead. implied_capacity_eps = offered - lag slope; do not quote it either.

reconciled.note: delivered_window_eps: events offered inside the steady window and present in the graph by end of emission, over the window. Cannot include warm-up backlog; cannot exceed the offered rate. warmup_drained_inside_window is the contamination that the legacy steady_delivered_eps counted as throughput. lost_window is permanent (absent after drain); pending_at_emit_end arrived late but arrived.

wallclock.note: accepted_eps = accepted_total / wall. commit_eps = activities added between the warm-up sample (wall t = warmup_s) and end of emission, over that wall span. drain_eps = pending at emit end over the seconds the consumer took to clear it with no new load. If emitter_behind_schedule_x is far above 1, the offered rate was never reached and reconciled.delivered_window_eps is not a sustained rate: quote these.

slo.note: A passing SLO permits up to loss_limit of accepted events to be permanently missing. That is a performance criterion, not audit completeness: reconciled.lost_window is the number of acknowledged events that never reached the graph.

method.slo: lag trend <= 0.01 x offered rate, fitted by least squares after warm-up; and <= 0.01 of accepted events missing from the graph
